<h2>Leadership Roles</h2>

<p><strong>2023–2026 · Program Board Leader, Data Science Department — NMBU</strong><br>
Oversaw development and implementation of the department's academic programmes. Coordinated with faculty, staff, and external stakeholders, and led programme meetings and departmental projects.</p>

<h2>Examination & Censor Roles</h2>

<p>External examiner and academic censor for Bachelor's and Master's theses across Norwegian universities. Responsibilities include independent assessment, oral examination participation, grading, and feedback.</p>
